signIn.title: Minnegela
signIn.tagline: A search engine for your friend group's memories. Friends only ever see events you were at together. Everything else stays yours.
signIn.badCode: That code did not work. Check it and try again.

profile.title: What should friends call you?
profile.footer: Your name is shown to members of groups you join, on the events you were part of.

groupSetup.title: Your group
groupSetup.joinHint: Ask the friend who runs the group for a code. Codes last 7 days.

permissions.title: Your photos
permissions.what1: It reads your library to build a private index of when and where photos were taken, and uploads small previews to your group's server so faces and events can be recognised there.
permissions.what2: Friends only ever see events you were at together. A hike alone, a screenshot, a receipt: those never leave your view.
permissions.what3: Your library syncs fastest while the app is open and the phone is on Wi-Fi and charging. We keep going in the background when the phone lets us.
permissions.limited: You gave access to a selection of photos. Only those will be indexed.

enroll.title: Teach it your face
enroll.intro: Pick 3 to 5 photos of yourself: front, slightly left, slightly right, and one with your usual glasses or hat.
enroll.why: This is the switch that lets friends' photos of you count as "you were there", which is what unlocks those events for you. You can turn it off any time; that deletes your face data on the server.
enroll.visibleBody: Until you enroll, you only see events you photographed yourself. Enrollment lets the server recognise you in friends' photos and share those nights with you.

policy.title: How to sync
policy.hint: Previews are about 300 KB each and are what the recognition runs on. Originals are kept for downloads and never re-analysed.

home.fullSyncHint: Full sync runs pass after pass until your library is up, with the screen kept awake. Fastest on Wi-Fi while charging. Background sync continues when the phone allows it.
home.enrollWaiting_one: Waiting for the server to find your face on {{count}} reference photo.
home.enrollWaiting_other: Waiting for the server to find your face on {{count}} reference photos.
home.enrollLater: This finishes on a later sync.
home.analyzing_one: {{count}} item still being analysed on the server.
home.analyzing_other: {{count}} items still being analysed on the server.
home.noEvents: No events yet. They appear as photos are analysed.
home.setWebUrl: Set the web app URL under Group to open events.

group.title: Group
group.shareMessage: Join our Minnegela group with code {{code}} (valid 7 days). Server: {{server}}

library.title: Library rules
library.sinceLabel: Only photos since (YYYY-MM-DD, empty for all)
library.footer: Excluded photos are never indexed for the group. Anything already uploaded from an album you exclude stays until you delete it from the web app.

privacy.title: People & privacy
privacy.whoBody: There are no sharing settings. Being at an event, as the photographer or as a face in someone's photo, is the only key that unlocks it. Everything else in your library is invisible to the group.
privacy.viewersHint: Per-event viewers are listed on each event in the web app ("Visible to you, Emma and Jonas").
privacy.enrollProgress_one: Enrollment in progress: {{count}} reference photo waiting for analysis.
privacy.enrollProgress_other: Enrollment in progress: {{count}} reference photos waiting for analysis.
privacy.embeddings: Face embeddings never leave the server and are never shown or exported. Withdrawing consent deletes them.

exportQueued.title: Export queued
exportQueued.body: A zip of your originals and metadata will be prepared on the server.

privacy.deleteBody: Scheduled with a 7-day grace period. Sign in again within 7 days to cancel.

turnOff.title: Turn off face recognition?
turnOff.body: Your face data on the server is deleted. Friends' photos of you stop counting as "you were there", so those events disappear for you unless you also contributed photos.

sync.stoppingHint: Finishing the current step so nothing is left half-done.
sync.running: Running for {{duration}}. Keep the app open; the screen stays awake. Fastest on Wi-Fi while charging.

enumerate.title: Reading your library
enumerate.hint: Finding photos and videos on this phone

reconcile.title: Checking for deletions
reconcile.hint: Photos you removed are removed for the group too

manifest.title: Checking with the server
manifest.hint: Which of these does the group not have yet?

preview.title: Uploading previews
preview.hint: Small copies for face and event detection

original.title: Uploading originals
original.hint: Full quality, when the policy allows it

enroll.title: Teaching it your face
enroll.hint: Your reference photos are being enrolled

idle.title: Starting the next pass
idle.hint: Each pass is bounded so progress is never lost

drained.title: All caught up
drained.body: Everything on this phone that the rules allow is with the group. Background sync keeps it that way.

waiting.title: Done for now
waiting.body: Some uploads are waiting for the right conditions, usually Wi-Fi or charging. They continue on their own when the phone allows it.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.body: Progress is saved. Run a full sync again any time to continue where it left off.

stalled.title: Paused
stalled.body: The last passes made no progress. Check the connection, then try again.

limit.title: Taking a break
limit.body: Fifty passes ran. Start another full sync to keep going.

errors.not_found: Could not find what you were looking for.
errors.not_allowed: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.validation_failed: Something in the request was invalid.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.internal_error: The server hit a problem. Try again in a bit.
errors.owner_only: Only the group owner can do this.
errors.invite_invalid: That invite is invalid, used or expired.
errors.boundary_edits_contributors_only: Only contributors can change an event's boundaries.
errors.open_close_contributors_only: Only contributors can open or close an event.
errors.split_contributors_only: Only contributors can split an event.
errors.split_point_outside_event: The split point must be inside the event.
errors.no_assets_in_scope: None of those photos are available to you.
errors.member_person_cannot_merge: A person linked to a member cannot be merged away.
errors.enroll_own_identity_only: Only that member can enroll their own identity.
errors.no_faces_on_reference_photos: No faces found on the reference photos yet; they may still be analysing.
errors.face_crop_not_ready: The face crop is not ready yet.
errors.face_crop_missing: The face crop is missing from storage.
errors.upload_exceeds_size_cap: The file is larger than can be uploaded.
